method: Union of each route's client-reference manifest, polyfills and root runtime; gzip applied per emitted JavaScript chunk. This is a deterministic build-manifest ceiling, not a measured browser transfer or Core Web Vitals trace.
limitations: Manifest membership can include lazily requested chunks and therefore is an upper bound.
Cold/warm HTTP transfer, LCP, CLS, INP and heap growth require the Chrome DevTools MCP trace service, which was unavailable in this session.
The authenticated deployed app is older than this build, so its network payload would not validate the current branch.
